name: Injoku Furin ~Yaribeya ni Sarete Choukyou Sareta Shoujo~
original_name: 淫辱不倫 ～ヤリ部屋にされて調教された少女～
source: The story is about Matsui Yuusuke, an elite corporate employee who neglects his family due to his intense focus on work. One day, he encounters Manabe Kanon, who sees a striking resemblance between Yuusuke and her deceased father. Yuusuke, feeling distant from his wife and Kanon, struggling with her father's loss, decide to live together to ease their loneliness. They hope to share warm and peaceful moments akin to a real parent-child relationship, but their lives take a turn. A significant mistake by his subordinate leads to Yuusuke losing his job, shattering his career-driven pride. Under immense stress, he assaults Kanon, committing a grievous act.
translation: 故事讲述的是松井雄介，一位企业精英员工，由于过于专注于工作而忽视了家庭。有一天，他遇到了真锅加音，真锅加音发现佑介和她已故的父亲有着惊人的相似之处。雄介感到与妻子和加隆的距离越来越远，并因失去父亲而苦苦挣扎，决定住在一起以缓解他们的孤独感。他们希望能分享像真正的亲子关系一样温暖、平静的时刻，但他们的生活却发生了转变。下属的一个重大错误导致雄介丢掉了工作，粉碎了他以职业为导向的自豪感。在巨大的压力下，他袭击了卡隆，做出了令人悲痛的行为。
